map.由半径与转角求中弦垂距 使用指南: Mid-ordinate from radius and deflection angle guide
map.输入圆曲线半径 R 与路线转角 Δ（度），按 M=R·(1−cos(Δ/2)): Enter the circular curve radius R and route deflection angle Delta (degrees) to compute the mid-ordinate (middle ordinate) by M = R x (1 - cos(Delta/2)), for horizontal curve element computation and stakeout checks of the curve midpoint.
map.输入圆曲线半径 R 与转角 Δ（度），求中点垂距。: Enter the circular curve radius R and deflection angle Delta (degrees) to get the mid-ordinate.
map.由半径转角算中点弦 M。: Compute the mid-ordinate M from radius and angle.
map.曲线中点定位。: Locating the midpoint of a curve.
map.：R=200m、Δ=60° → M=R(1−cos(Δ/2))=200×(1−c: : R=200 m, Delta=60 degrees -> M = R(1 - cos(Delta/2)) = 200 x (1 - cos 30 degrees) = 200 x 0.13397, about 26.8 m, the perpendicular distance from the intersection point to the curve midpoint.
map.：由 JD 沿分角线量 E 得曲线中点 QZ，或量 M 校验，与 T/L 配套。: : measure E from JD along the angle bisector to reach the curve midpoint QZ, or measure M to verify, together with T/L.
map.由两端与中截面面积求棱台体积: Frustum volume from the two end areas and the mid-section area
map.由后视前视累计求待定点高程: Elevation of an unknown point from backsight/foresight accumulation
map.M=R(1−cos(Δ/2))，Δ 越大 M 越大，反映曲线越弯。: M = R(1 - cos(Delta/2)); the larger Delta is, the larger M is, reflecting a sharper curve.
map.E 和 M 区别？: How do E and M differ?
map.E 是交点到 QZ 的斜距（沿分角线）、M 是垂距，E>M 因含切向分量。: E is the oblique distance from the intersection point to QZ (along the angle bisector), M is the perpendicular distance; E > M because it includes the tangential component.
